select * from checktemplate
and Name like concat('%', #{Name}, '%')
and UserID like concat('%', #{UserID}, '%')
and RecordType like concat('%', #{RecordType}, '%')
order by ID
mapper.insert: insert into checktemplate(Name, UserID, CreationTime, Scope, RecordType, DelMark) values (#{Name}, #{UserID}, #{CreationTime}, #{Scope}, #{RecordType}, #{DelMark})
mapper.update: update checktemplate set Name=#{Name}, UserID=#{UserID}, Scope=#{Scope}, RecordType=#{RecordType}, DelMark=#{DelMark} where ID = #{ID}
